description: React component for the Career Navigator application UI. Handles file uploads, draft generation, state management, and rendering of the multi-step persona creation process.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React component managing the entire UI state, user interactions, and rendering logic for the Persona generation workflow.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles user selection of files from file input, validates and updates uploaded files state, and initiates upload process.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop file uploads, adding dropped files to the upload list.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the uploaded files list by its ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers the process to generate a draft persona by uploading files and calling API endpoints.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to the backend.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Marks the current persona as finalized.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-generates the draft persona based on current build ID and persona ID.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs available keys in orchestration objects for debugging purposes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from orchestration responses.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON into the app's PersonaData format.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for the current persona data for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for a persona artifact JSON object to detect changes.
